descriptor: 2D8-neighbor self-similarity: patchSSD3x3, cardinal variance, minimum-subtracted/max-normalized exponential; MIND-inspired diagnostic, not exact published3Dregistration.
evaluation: All24 full-image fields serialized on a fixed uniform grid before opening GT. Only then evaluate current-frame class1 bbox support, excluding wrong-frame class1 boxes for current-vs-wrong comparisons. Bounding boxes are not true pixel correspondences. Gray synthetic translations are the only known displacement truth.
prerequisite: Known translated gray exact recovery>=0.8 on textured foreground in EACH6Trainvideos; actualIR current-vs-wrong mean bestcost lower and inverse-consistent fraction higher in at least4/6videos. A passing diagnostic only motivates further registration, never authorizes a HOTA/novelty claim or new full cache automatically.
storage: CPUonly, noCUDA, no fullimages/encoders/weights; only downsampled uniform-grid diagnostics expected<0.03GiB. ExistingTrainRGB and actualNovemberIR read-only.
common_comparison_mask: All3IR views use the intersection of their textured source-grid masks, current foreground minus wrong foreground. Same pixel denominator for all3. Gray positive control has its own valid textured mask.

amendment_before_any_GT_or_accuracy.reason: Align all IR comparison denominators before labels are opened; first partial producer stopped with no frozen24-field/GT report, retained privately. No prediction values inspected.
